visual-language.direction.evidence: sistema-review/style-preview.html (7 sections, specimen renders on Relay content, palette-tool ramps, contrast-tool checks). Owner's answers: 1 Quiet (proposed Brand), 2 Violet 550 #7B43E6 (proposed Purple 550; petrol and plum rejected), 3 accent-tinted grays, confirmed 'Tinted' after the plain-gray comparison, 4 8px, 5 Scaled chips (proposed Pill), 6 Shadow (proposed Tone), 7 Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (proposed IBM Plex Sans); density, theme, emphasis map as proposed. Approved: 'yes'.
